newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian court sentences Mafiosi to life in prison.
newsitem.headline: Italian court sentences Mafiosi to life in prison.

text.p: An Italian court on Friday sentenced nine members of a crime gang to life in prison after they were found guilty of murder and extortion.

The court in the southern city of Foggia also sentenced 47 other members of the group to various prison terms for crimes ranging from drug trafficking and extortion to kidnapping and Mafia association.
The ring, which operated mainly in the town of Cerignola near Foggia, was smashed in June 1994 when scores of its members were arrested.
The trial, which began in December 1995, found the group guilty of at least five murders.
